messages:
deploybot: Production deploy started for service=inference-gateway env=prod owner=@sophia commit=9f3b2a7 tag=v3.6.0-window change_window=2026-03-20T18:00Z-18:30Z :rocket:

sophia: Ack. Running quick preflight checks now. Will watch canary for 10m.

tom: Heads up - I left a small config tweak in the rollout plan to pin the kv-cache default to 0.9 for the canary. Should be safe.

anita: Noted. Will keep an eye on SLOs and error budget dashboards.

deploybot: Canary rollout started: 2% traffic -> 2 nodes (us-east-1). Canary health: passing initial readiness checks.

sophia: Can you post the canary prometheus query?

deploybot: prometheus query: `rate(requests_total{service="inference-gateway",job="canary"}[1m])`

infra-monitor-bot: Alert: latency spike detected on edge-proxy-usw2, 95th p99 increased from 120ms to 420ms for ~45s. Correlating with canary traffic.

tom: That's the small spike I expected, could be a cold path on kv-cache. Sophia: want to pause and pin to 0% while we inspect?

sophia: Pause canary. Let's keep baseline traffic on previous release.

deploybot: Canary paused at 2% per request from @sophia. Pinning traffic back to stable. Rolling back canary traffic.

(anita uploaded: brief telemetry snippet)

anita: Telemetry shows transient 502s from edge-proxy; origin nodes healthy. Looks like a cache-miss amplification.

tom: I'll flip the kv-cache tweak back to 0.85 for the rollout config and re-run smoke in staging then resume.

sophia: Approved. Do the config patch and promote canary when green.

deploybot: Config patch applied to canary rollout: kv_cache_default=0.85 commit=9f3b2a7-patch1. Re-deploying canary pods.

deploybot: Canary resumed at 2%. Health checks passing for 3m. No new 502 spikes.

sophia: Running smoke scripts (curl/compare responses) -> all good.

anita: Observability looks stable. Error budget within tolerance.

tom: Incrementing traffic to 20% now.

deploybot: Traffic shifted to 20%. Canary nodes scaled to 8.

(infra-monitor-bot posted): Notice: small transient DB connection errors at 03:24UTC unrelated to canary.

sophia: Those DB errors are unrelated, infra team has a ticket. Proceeding with rollout.

deploybot: Progressive rollout: 50% traffic at 03:28UTC.

sophia: Monitoring 50% -> 100% over 5m window.

deploybot: Finalizing promotion: shifting remaining 50% to v3.6.0.

sophia: All checks green from my side.

anita: SLOs okay, cost delta within expected.

deploybot: Production deploy complete: service=inference-gateway env=prod tag=v3.6.0 commit=9f3b2a7 total_time=18m status=success :tada:

tom: Nice. Can we add a follow-up note to release notes about kv-cache default change and the canary pause?

sophia: Yep, I'll add a short blurb and link to the rollout trace.

deploybot: Rollout trace: https://deploys.redwood.example/trace/2467778888

anita: Marking post-deploy eval job to run at +1h.

sophia: Thanks team. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
